secret_header: x-payment-workflow-secret (server/runtime secret; no value in this file)
per_enrollment_values_required: server-issued workflow_run_id returned by the first reserved preflight, retained through waits and callbacks
case_id returned by first preflight, retained for the same invoice's second step
context_token returned for the current reminder step; never a contact custom field

first_preflight.continue_only_when: reserved === true; preflight.authorised_send must remain false

dispatch.native_action: Send the exact approved template to the same trigger contact immediately; disable automatic native-action retries. Only the approved Contact First Name variable is used.

body.event_id: <unique native status event ID, stable on retry>

receipt.continue_only_when: receipt.verified === true AND receipt.state is sent/delivered AND followup_due_at is present
receipt.unknown_or_failed: Exit the automatic path and leave Eimear's payment task open. Never invent a message ID or retry a native send.

followup.then: Save the new second-step token; repeat dispatch and verified receipt; stop after two reminders and retain Eimear's task.

builder_checks_still_required: Use the server-issued handoff value. Workflow/contact/transaction IDs are not substituted for a native enrollment ID.
Prove node response data survive the wait per enrollment, without shared mutable contact fields.
Prove the native action exposes an actual provider message ID and its retry control.
Recheck both exact templates' approval and rendered Contact First Name mapping.
Prove both external Stripe merchants reach their signed invoice endpoints and the correct verified contact binding.
